title: Finance 1:1 prep - run-rate, spend review & procurement (Q1 2026)
content:
Meeting goals:
- Align on current run-rate and variances vs. Q1 plan
- Review large vendor spend & procurement approvals pending
- Confirm headcount hiring plan impact to run-rate
- Agree next steps for committed cloud discounts and Dedicated capacity purchases

Notes / context:
- Run-rate (internal calc): ~$1.35M/month (ex-capitalized projects). Main deltas: GPU spot->on-demand migration for Dedicated pilot (+$120k mo), slower credit usage offset by higher-hosted traffic. Need to reconcile with ledger (Samir to confirm numbers).
- Procurement items pending:
  1) Dedicated GPU pool vendor (vendor: AuroraCompute) - PO request for $1.2M annual commitment (approvals needed from legal + procurement). Contract delays due to SLA clause.
  2) Datadog retention increase (logs): $18k/year - lower priority but needs procurement sign-off before new retention kicks in.
  3) NGC model license (opt) - $120k one-time dev license; technical team requests pilot for Private deployments.
- Headcount: hiring plan unchanged at +6 ICs in infra/serving runtime this quarter. Impact to run-rate: +$120k/mo (salary + benefits + bench). We should discuss tradeoffs: delay 2 backend hires vs. keep model onboarding velocity.
- Forecast: current Q1 burn vs plan shows +9% variance. Biggest drivers: infra (GPUs) and travel (one-off conference). Recommendation: reclassify $200k of one-off infra into CapEx/commit and reproject monthly run-rate.

Questions for manager:
- Approve starting legal review for AuroraCompute contract this week?
- Ok to move forward with NGC license pilot (engineering committed to initial ROI assessment in 6 weeks)?
- Do you want to freeze non-critical hiring (2 positions) if runway dips below 11 months?
- Any preference on moving Datadog approval to next quarter to conserve cash?

Quick talking points:
- Emphasize cost-per-token improvements from caching & quantization recommendations - those will lower hosted API marginals in Q2
- Highlight SLA risk if we don't secure dedicated capacity for enterprise customers (pipeline at risk)
- Show scenario: freeze two hires -> runway +3 months, but model onboarding delayed ~6 weeks

Tone: factual, ask for clear yes/no on procurement approvals and hiring tradeoffs. Be ready with numbers and linked JIRA/Confluence pages.
action_items: Samir: reconcile accounting run-rate calc and send updated spreadsheet (due 2026-02-18)
Priya: open legal intake for AuroraCompute PO and flag SLA clause (due 2026-02-20)
Ethan: prepare short ROI note for NGC license pilot (1 pager) and share with eng lead (due 2026-02-22)
Finance: move $200k one-off infra to CapEx line and update forecast (due 2026-02-25)
Ethan: schedule procurement review meeting with procurement+legal+eng (30-45 min) (due 2026-02-19)
summary: Prep notes for 1:1 to resolve procurement approvals and align on run-rate. Primary asks: legal intake for AuroraCompute, decision on NGC license pilot, and quick confirmation on hiring freeze threshold.
